The '''Kalaides Harvesters Guild''' was an organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cols/Legends|Cols]]. It was concerned with the raising and harvesting of the native [[kalaide]]s.<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
